title: A tourist is lost near your office
instructionsRu: Ты идёшь на работу, и тебя останавливает турист. Объясни ему дорогу до вокзала и помоги с советами. Отвечай на каждую реплику.
material: You are near your office in the city centre. A tourist with a big suitcase stops you.

items.text: Excuse me, sorry to bother you! Could you tell me how to get to the central railway station?
Is it far? I've got this heavy suitcase, so I'm not sure I can walk there.
And what if I miss my train? It leaves at ten past nine.
Do you know a good place near the station where I can have breakfast?
Thank you so much! By the way, have you ever been to my country, Portugal?

examples: if you miss it, you can take the next one
you'll see it if you turn left
i have never been to portugal
i've lived here for five years
